sections.title: Payout
sections.sql: select po.name,p.name practitioner,p.discipline,po.through_on receipts_through,po.paid_on,po.reference,po.currency,po.amount_cents from payouts po join practitioners p on p.id=po.practitioner_id where po.id=$1
sections.note: A record of what the practice paid. No money moves from this file.

sections.title: Fees received and your share
sections.sql: select i.name invoice,c.name client,pm.paid_on,i.currency,pm.amount_cents received_cents,l.split_pct,l.practitioner_cents your_share_cents from payout_lines l join payments pm on pm.id=l.payment_id join invoices i on i.id=pm.invoice_id join clients c on c.id=i.client_id where l.payout_id=$1 order by pm.paid_on
sections.note: Client names are health information. Send only to the practitioner who saw them.

name: referrer-report
title: Report to referrer: practitioner draft
for_each: select id,name from referrals where funder='Better Access'

sections.title: Course record
sections.note: Draft only. Check consent to disclose. The practitioner adds assessments, treatment provided and recommendations.

sections.title: Sessions this course
sections.sql: select starts_at,status from sessions where referral_id=$1 order by starts_at

name: statement
title: Account statement
for_each: select id,name from clients where id in (select client_id from invoices)

sections.title: Invoices and receipts
sections.sql: select name,payer,currency,amount_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents,due_on from v_debtors where id in (select id from invoices where client_id=$1) order by due_on
sections.note: Amounts in the invoice currency. Check the payer and recipient before sharing.

name: session-summary
title: Clinical record: restricted
for_each: select id,id::text as name from sessions where status='completed'

sections.title: Practitioner record
sections.sql: select body,author,finalised_at from notes where session_id=$1
sections.note: Draft until finalised. Written by the practitioner, not generated by software.

sections.title: Dated corrections
sections.sql: select a.body,a.author,a.created_at from addenda a join notes n on n.id=a.note_id where n.session_id=$1 order by a.created_at
